```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(svglite)
library(kableExtra)
library(showtext)

setwd(here::here())

#font_add_google("IBM Plex Sans", "ibm")
extrafont::loadfonts()
week_sel=6

pretty_table <- function(x){
  kable(x) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"),
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
}

source("scripts/league_data.R")
```

[See all the recaps for the 2026 season](https://jshannon75.github.io/pcfl/)

## Week `r week_sel` Headlines

* NEW: Playoff odds show a clear top 4
* Bye weeks take a toll (except for Evan)
* The Captain remains undefeated
* Jacob's bench gets donuts

## Last week's games

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(lastweek_results)
```

Sarah had a dominant showing, just an 11 yard reception short of 200 points. Four players on her team scored 30+ points, and one (Bucky Irving) was on the bench! It was a very strong week.

The byes hurt pretty much everyone. Everyone besides Jumpin' Jaheims (Evan) scored well below their average thus far.

## Best performances

### Best players overall
Here's last week's **10 best performing players.** 

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(top_n(starters,10,Points) %>%
        arrange(-Points))
```

Jayden Daniels makes an appearance in the top 10. No truly standout performances this week, though.

### Best bench
Who won the **best scoring bench** award last week?

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(starter_benchteam %>% 
        arrange(-`Bench points`) %>%
  rename(Team=`PCFL Team`))
```

Oof--low scoring benches, with the GOAT (Jacob) getting ZERO points!

#### Season bench standings

```{r}
#| eval: true

pretty_table(starter_benchteam_all %>%

 rename(Team=name))
```

Sarah's back on top here.

### Waiver masters

I've tallied the players picked up by each team since the draft and the points they've contributed as starters. Here's where those stand.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(roster_pickup %>%
        select(-abbrev) %>%
        rename(Team=name,Points=draftpoints,
               Transactions=draft_num) %>%
        arrange(-Points)) 
```

### Recapping the draft

## Looking ahead

### League standings

Our league standings are a little unusual. We rank teams based on points, kinda like hockey. There are two ways to get points:

* Win your weekly matchup (1 point)
* Finish in the top six point scorers (1 point)

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(standings)
```

Note the drop in points scored between the Sharks and Team Sasquatch. It's a WIDE gap.

### Playoff Odds

I've created 10,000 simulations of the remaining matchups based on teams' performances so far. Here's what playoff odds look like based on those results:

```{r}
#| echo: false
pretty_table(playoff_odds %>%
  mutate(
    Odds      = scales::percent(PlayoffOdds, accuracy = 0.1),
    TopSeed   = scales::percent(TopSeed, accuracy = 0.1),
    AvgSeed   = round(AvgSeed, 2),
    ExpPoints = round(ExpPoints, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Team = name, Odds, TopSeed, AvgSeed, ExpPoints))
```

As the standings suggest, there's a very strong top 4 right now. That could change, but the simulations don't think so!
